entities.summary: Donald J. Ford is an American former professional basketball player who was a power forward in the National Basketball Association (NBA) for the Los Angeles Lakers and Cleveland Cavaliers. He also was a member of the Auxilium Torino in Europe. He played college basketball for the UC Santa Barbara Gauchos.
